metadata.description: Claude plugins for TMS Software developer products.

plugins.name: tms-fnc
plugins.description: Build Delphi apps (VCL, FMX, TMS WEB Core) with TMS FNC UI Pack and TMS FNC Core: add DataGrid, TreeView, Planner, RichEditor, Kanban, inputs, pickers and more, use Core graphics, PDF, web browser, JSON and persistence, and review FNC code against the real API.
